facts.fact: Adwave runs ads across streaming TV, Meta, Google, TikTok, Reddit, web, and mobile from one daily budget starting at $30/day, per Adwave's own page.
facts.quote: runs them across streaming TV, Meta, Google, TikTok, Reddit, web, and mobile from one daily budget starting at $30/day

facts.fact: Adwave's page states that CTV and multichannel campaigns on Adwave can start at $30 per day.
Adwave's page suggests a $30 to $50/day multichannel campaign for early-growth apps while the core UA stack runs elsewhere.
facts.quote: that can mean a $30 to $50/day multichannel campaign while your core UA stack runs elsewhere

facts.fact: Adwave's page says a few hundred dollars a day split between Meta or Apple Search Ads and creative production is enough for a pre-launch paid test.
facts.quote: A few hundred dollars a day split between Meta or Apple Search Ads and creative production is enough to learn

facts.fact: The page states Apple Search Ads CPI often lands in the mid tens to low hundreds of dollars depending on category competitiveness.
facts.quote: CPI often lands in the mid tens to low hundreds of dollars depending on category competitiveness

facts.fact: The page reports that many teams see Google App Campaigns CPI from roughly $1 to $3 for some casual games up to $20 to $80+ for subscription and finance apps.
facts.quote: Many teams see productive ranges from roughly $1 to $3 for some casual games up through $20 to $80+ for subscription and finance apps

facts.fact: The page states CTV category CPMs commonly land in the mid teens to forties, depending on targeting and season.
facts.quote: Category CPMs for CTV commonly land in the mid teens to forties, depending on targeting and season.

facts.fact: The page advises keeping 10 to 20% of media for brand or CTV experiments during early growth.
facts.quote: Keep 10 to 20% of media for brand or CTV experiments

facts.fact: The page states influencer pricing runs from a few hundred dollars for micro creators to five figures for larger names, often plus a CPA kicker.
facts.quote: Pricing runs from a few hundred dollars for micro creators to five figures for larger names, often plus a CPA kicker.

facts.fact: The page states Adwave's suite is not a five-figure CTV-only contract requirement, with multichannel buys available from $30/day.
facts.quote: You are not forced into a five-figure CTV-only contract to test living-room reach.

facts.fact: The page states the article was published on 2026-03-30.
Sitewide Adwave starts at $30/day on a prepaid wallet.
facts.quote: Sitewide Adwave starts at $30/day on a prepaid wallet.

facts.fact: Adwave lets advertisers approve ads before any spend occurs and pause campaigns at any time, per the vendor's description.
facts.quote: You approve ads before spend, pause anytime, and see one report across the channels in the campaign.

facts.fact: According to Adwave, one prepaid wallet and one daily budget can cover streaming TV, Meta, Google, TikTok, and more.
